_comment: Fly.io variant of the c1 rail config. Fill secrets LOCALLY, then sftp to /data/c1_rail_config.json on the volume — NEVER commit. Deltas vs the generic template: bind_host=0.0.0.0 (Fly's edge terminates TLS; the app binds the container interface, NOT loopback — the only ingress is Fly's proxy), bind_port=8080 (== fly.toml internal_port), and all paths under /data. path_token >=32 random chars. B6 PASSED 2026-07-20: the pinned live values are `equity_source='crosstrade'` and `equity_field='balance.netLiq'`. This template deliberately still ships the fail-closed `'file'` default and the `REPLACE_` placeholder - set both consciously when rebuilding the volume config; `RUNBOOK.md` L132 lists every correct value.
_armed_until_comment: Absolute ISO-8601 UTC deadline for the armed window, e.g. '2026-07-28T17:15:00+00:00'. REQUIRED whenever dry_run is false: the host refuses to boot armed without a valid future value, and handle_signal fail-safes to EXPIRED (blocking entry/add, never exit/flat) once it lapses. Absolute by design — a duration-from-boot would be re-granted in full on every restart, which is the exact failure this closes. null while disarmed.
